acceptance_checks: scripts/shiki_tasks.py defines a single predicate returning (satisfied, reason) that decides the SADR-0015 pre-dispatch gate, and it is the only place that decision is made.

That predicate obtains the compared field list from mergegate_check._NORMAL_PATH_GOVERNANCE_FIELDS; scripts/shiki_tasks.py declares no second copy of the seven field names, and a test binds the compared set to that imported constant so a future edit to either cannot silently diverge.

scripts/shiki_runtime.py dispatch_runner_task refuses a high/critical task whose contract is absent from or unequal to the remote default branch, raising ShikiError with the predicate's reason, in the same style as the existing evaluate_lock_grant refusal at :545-547. A test drives the real dispatch_runner_task for both the admit and the refuse case.

The gate is enforced on the Goal Loop's dispatch path: `grep -c 'dispatchable_task_ids\|cmd_dispatch_check' scripts/shiki_loop.py` still returns 0, and a high/critical task with no registered contract is nevertheless refused when dispatched through dispatch_runner_task.

cmd_dispatch_check consults the predicate, and the string "guardian approval required for high/critical risk" is no longer emitted as an unconditional blocker. Measured before the change: `shiki dispatch check T-20260822T103718387283Z-2f3b0b54` returns it even though that task's contract is present at origin/main.
shiki dispatch check on a high/critical task whose contract is registered and unchanged returns that task's contract-gate field as satisfied and does not list the gate among blocking_reasons.
dispatchable_task_ids consults the SAME predicate and omits a high/critical task the predicate refuses.

A binder test in tests/test_dispatch_contract_registration.py proves ALL THREE surfaces agree on ONE task in BOTH directions: registered and unchanged means dispatch check reports dispatchable, the id appears in dispatchable_task_ids, and dispatch_runner_task proceeds; absent or unequal means dispatch check reports not dispatchable, the id does not appear, and dispatch_runner_task refuses. The test fails if any one surface is changed without the others.
A high/critical task whose contract exists on the remote default branch and is equal on all seven governance fields is SATISFIED by the predicate.
A high/critical task whose contract is absent from the remote default branch is REFUSED, with a reason naming the task and the ref consulted.
For each of the seven governance fields individually, a high/critical task unequal on that field alone is REFUSED, with a reason naming that field.
A high/critical task whose registered contract differs ONLY on status, expected_pr or ledger_evidence is SATISFIED, proving the comparison is governance-fields-only and not whole-file.
A task whose effective risk is low or medium is SATISFIED without consulting the remote default branch.
Effective risk is max(local, registered) when a registered contract exists: a task recorded high on the remote but lowered to medium locally is still gated, and a test pins that case.

The predicate REFUSES when origin/<default> cannot be verified and never accepts the local branch as a substitute; a test proves a repository whose local default branch exists but whose origin/<default> does not is refused, not admitted.

The predicate fails closed on every verification failure: unresolvable default branch, failed or unavailable git, and an unparseable registered contract each return NOT satisfied with a named reason. No input returns satisfied by default.

The refusal reason names the Contract-PR remedy and warns that an already-acquired lock may need manual release, and contains no occurrence of the word "divergence"; tests/test_lock_lifecycle.py passes unchanged, including its assertion that exactly one blocking reason contains that word.

tests/test_session_lease.py passes with its DispatchEnv fixture rebuilt on the tests/test_repair_delivery.py recipe, and its four dispatch_runner_task calls still exercise the real dispatcher at risk high.

docs/agents/decision-control.md's Dispatch Guard JSON example matches the fields cmd_dispatch_check emits after this change, including blocking_reasons, and its surrounding prose no longer implies that guardian_approval_required: true alone forbids dispatch.
docs/agents/decision-control.md line 61 ("risk level does not require unresolved Guardian approval") is unchanged.
The predicate's docstring records that orchestrate_plan's own dispatchable list is DELIBERATELY not gated, and why.
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests passes.
python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py --target . passes.

scripts/test_shiki_module_boundaries.sh, test_shiki_control_plane.sh, test_shiki_run_orchestrator.sh, test_shiki_daemon_runner.sh, test_shiki_loop_lock_guard.sh, test_shiki_goal_loop.sh and test_shiki_runner_claude.sh all pass.
git diff --name-only against the merge base lists only files inside the declared locks.
scripts/shiki_guardian.py and scripts/shiki_contract_approval.py are byte-identical to their base versions.
non_goals: Modifying scripts/shiki_guardian.py, evaluate_guardian_approval, or any of the four existing approval sources. The pre-dispatch gate is a dispatch precondition, not an approval source.
Modifying scripts/shiki_contract_approval.py or either consumer of the merge-time Contract Approval carry.
Editing docs/adr/SADR-0015-contract-approval-before-dispatch.md. The record correction is the second task of this Goal and holds that lock.

Editing CONTEXT.md, which is held by the in-flight descope task T-20260822T103718387283Z-2f3b0b54. Its Contract PR entry already states the gate as domain law and becomes true on ship; it needs no edit.
Changing docs/agents/decision-control.md line 61; it already states the requirement this task makes true.
Changing how risk_level is resolved at MERGE time, or lowering any task's risk. The max(local, registered) resolution added here decides only whether the pre-dispatch gate APPLIES.

Gating scripts/shiki_tasks.py orchestrate_plan's own `dispatchable` list (:646-664). A freshly registered contract is by definition not yet on the remote, so gating plan registration would empty the dispatchable set for every high/critical plan and deadlock registration itself. Record the exclusion explicitly in the predicate docstring so it reads as deliberate rather than missed.
Extending tests/test_dispatch_lock_precondition.py in place. It carries the lock-precondition binder; the contract-registration binder belongs in the new tests/test_dispatch_contract_registration.py.

Modifying .shiki/schemas/dispatch-guard.schema.json. Its `required` already lists guardian_approval_required and blocking_reasons and it sets additionalProperties: true, so it already admits the new field; it is outside the declared locks.
Widening the compared set beyond the seven governance fields - notably to `dependencies`. DAG integrity is a separate concern; state it as out of scope in the docstring rather than silently widening.
Declaring a second copy of the seven governance field names. The list is imported from mergegate_check or the task is not done.

Adding a new module, and therefore adding any scripts/shiki_installer.py manifest entry or tests/test_install_completeness.py change. The predicate belongs beside evaluate_lock_grant in scripts/shiki_tasks.py.
Registering, backfilling, re-registering or otherwise mutating any contract under .shiki/tasks. Measured: no backfill is required.

Authoring a spec_freeze block, Guardian approval evidence, a CCA verdict, or any other approval record. An acceptance criterion that cannot be satisfied with the artifacts present in the worktree must be reported as a stop, never closed by manufacturing the missing artifact.
test_command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py --target . && bash scripts/test_shiki_module_boundaries.sh && bash scripts/test_shiki_control_plane.sh && bash scripts/test_shiki_run_orchestrator.sh && bash scripts/test_shiki_daemon_runner.sh && bash scripts/test_shiki_loop_lock_guard.sh && bash scripts/test_shiki_goal_loop.sh && bash scripts/test_shiki_runner_claude.sh
title: Enforce the SADR-0015 pre-dispatch gate on both dispatch surfaces
